checks.check: fidC DesRoll tracks target and stays <= ANGLE_MAX
highest legal wind 0 deg hover is non-catastrophic

headline: On the documented-supported GUIDED quaternion interface, a commanded attitude target > ANGLE_MAX is accepted unclamped (demanded attitude exceeds ANGLE_MAX), produces a real hard consequence, and the flight controller raises no preventive failsafe (interface-aware Tier-1 = 0). The contract-clean unsafe zone re-anchors on solid ground. Part C ABSENT: no run with ATT.DesRoll <= ANGLE_MAX under the legal wind/turbulence upper bound produced an unrecovered hard consequence with B = 0 in SITL; the demonstration rests on Tier B.
